stage._note: fitmon bench_press (Python backend): elbow bent is down, extended counts, 1000 ms. Ceiling 185: The same guard as the press. A ceiling makes the rep a whole cycle: it lands when the movement returns to rest, not when it first crosses the line, so a half rep cannot count.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Lie on your back, side-on to the camera, arms pressed straight up.
cues.tooHigh: Lower until the elbows pass ninety degrees.
cues.framing: I can't see your arms — move the phone back.
